goals.objective: Implement all required libsaturn library code and deliver two playable Pac-Man examples in this repo: (1) a 2D Pac-Man (no sound) and (2) a 3D Pac-Man using a VDP2 RBG0 infinite plane for the ground/background and true-perspective VDP1 distorted/scaled sprites + polygons for the 3D Pac-Man, ghosts, and maze. Done when both examples build as ISOs, are playable (movement, pellets, ghosts, win/lose), all host tests pass, and the headless harness probe plus emulator screenshots confirm they run.

tasks.title: Add 3D math + VDP1 scaled/distorted sprite library APIs
tasks.verificationContract: New public headers/APIs compile; host unit tests for projection math and VDP1 scaled/distorted command encoding pass; existing vdp1_logic tests stay green.

subtasks.title: 3D math module (vec3/mat4/projection, 16.16 fixed point)
subtasks.verificationContract: Host tests validate perspective projection and view/matrix transforms in fx16.
subtasks.evidence: src/core/math3d_logic.hpp + include/saturn/math3d.h + src/core/math3d_api.cpp; host tests test_math3d_logic.cpp 11 pass.

subtasks.title: VDP1 scaled + distorted sprite public API and logic encoding
subtasks.verificationContract: Host tests assert command select (0x0001/0x0002), zoom/vertex fields, and clipping flags; hal uses logic helpers (no magic numbers).
subtasks.evidence: sat_draw_sprite_scaled/distorted in vdp1.h/vdp1_api.cpp/hal; test_vdp1_logic.cpp 19 pass; SH2 hello_world builds.

tasks.evidence: make test all host tests passed (84). target build hello_world succeeded.

tasks.title: Playable 2D Pac-Man example (no sound)
tasks.verificationContract: example builds to ISO; harness probe runs N frames without crash; emulator screenshot shows maze, pellets, Pac-Man, ghosts; input moves Pac-Man and pellets are eaten.

tasks.title: Playable 3D Pac-Man example (VDP2 RBG0 infinite plane + polygon actors)
tasks.verificationContract: example builds to ISO; harness probe shows RBG0/BGON registers active; emulator screenshot shows 3D ground/background and perspective maze + polygon Pac-Man/ghosts; movement and ghost behavior work.

tasks.title: Full verification pass and evidence capture
tasks.verificationContract: All examples build; `make test` 0 failures; harness unittest suite passes; emulator run screenshots for both games attached/reported; re-read goal and confirm every criteria item addressed.
